name: @malte.muth/poker-hands-wasm
description: Texas Hold'em hand ranking and exact odds, compiled from Rust to WebAssembly, for Node.js and browsers

scripts.build: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg --release --no-typescript && wasm-opt pkg/poker_hands_bg.wasm -o pkg/poker_hands_bg.wasm -O3 --enable-reference-types --enable-multivalue --enable-bulk-memory --enable-mutable-globals --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-sign-ext && rm -f pkg/package.json pkg/.gitignore pkg/README.md

author: Malte Muth
